questions.stem: Zephyrwood uses 12 units of ceramic cookware per day and faces a 8-day supplier lead time with no safety stock. At what inventory level should it reorder?
questions.explanation: The reorder point without safety stock is daily demand multiplied by lead time in days: 12 units per day times 8 days equals 96 units. Ordering below that level risks running out before the new stock arrives.
questions.hint: Multiply daily usage by lead time in days.

questions.explanation: Reorder point equals 44 units a day times 26 days of lead time, or 1144 units. A lower trigger would leave a gap between running out and replenishment.
questions.hint: Multiply daily usage by lead time in days.
